# Coldwold Flaskworks - order ledger

The ledger takes order rows all day and its index is rebuilt after every bulk import.
The clause forms the crew agreed on are carded in sql/index-builds.tsv.

turns.prompt: Coldwold Flaskworks rebuilds an index on a ledger table that takes order rows all day, and the rebuild must not hold new writes off the table while it runs. Give the keyword that goes right after CREATE INDEX so the build lets writes continue. Reply with only the final answer.
